mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% simultaneously, but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
